title: Reset the three-Action rehearsal fixture for run 3 (one Action's text and the Plan date on fixture main; rejects only run 2's pending complete proposal; no production change)
problem: Run 2 of the three-Action rehearsal left fixture main at its reset head 0d3d2cedc5548da41896201688a1dc0210208ea4, a passed development attempt for write-start-marker's run-2 input (revision 7a8dd4f5960f…; the original was 959a3b12c686…), and its candidate preserved on branch claude/write-start-marker-20261005T155147519Z and pull request #2 at 7f1390376f4d49215cd29fd98145d40198475613, beside run 1's branch and pull request #1 at 58bcd9155cf64836994045ca63a7707d8b9ebe75. Arcadia never relaunches a passed development attempt for an unchanged requirement input, so run 3 needs a third input revision. Run 2 also lost 33 minutes to Issue #968: a pending Agent Ask proposal naming write-start-marker made the dispatch gate answer 'decision' and the tick launched nothing without saying why. Run 2's own complete proposal (complete-write-start-marker-2026-10-05) is still pending and would gate run 3 the same way. The 2026-10-05 reset is consumed and retired from use: it only resets from G1's genesis.
desired_effect: Rewrite only write-start-marker's next_action in the fixture Plan (a run-3 note on the original sentence) and set the Plan's updated: date to the reset's UTC date, which changes its requirement input revision a third time while its acceptance criteria, responsibility, execution, title and the other two Actions stay byte-identical. docs sync applies a Plan whose date is equal to or later than its record's (same-day edits pass, src/docs/sync.ts stalenessOf), so the date line stays unchanged when the reset runs on the Plan's own date 2026-10-05; a host date before the Plan's date refuses with the remedy. Validate the amendment with Arcadia's own discovery, a throwaway dry-run docs sync, resolveReadySet and requirementIdentity, and a read-only dry-run docs sync against the live workspace that must report write-start-marker as an update. Refuse every pending Agent Ask proposal or Decision that gates a fixture Action, and every pending fixture proposal, except exactly run 2's complete proposal, which it rejects through arcadia agent-ask settle --disposition rejected (preview, then --apply with that exact fingerprint, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE inline on that one command and never exported) before the commit, then confirms the gate is clear. Commit once on fixture main, push without force, run docs sync, and write a receipt carrying the new fixture head, all candidate tips and the superseded proposal that the run-3 G6 and G7 bind. Run it from a terminal: ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO=pmark/arcadia-three-action-rehearsal-20261004 /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-run3-2026-10-05.sh run

parameters.ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO: Required environment variable: the exact owner/name of the fixture repository G1 prepared. The owner must be the authenticated gh user and the name must match ^arcadia-three-action-rehearsal(-[a-z0-9]{1,24})?$. Launched from /runs without it, the script refuses with a receipt and changes nothing.

does: Refuses before any other step unless ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO is exactly owner/name with a safe disposable-fixture name; requires the Arcadia checkout clean on main, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE not exported, this descriptor's agentAsk declaring exactly run 2's proposal, the CLI default workspace martianrover from user config, and production readable, Inactive and with zero live admissions (rechecked immediately before the proposal settle and before the push)

Requires the earlier runs' records: a succeeded G1 receipt for this exact repository (its genesis), a succeeded run-2 reset receipt (reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-2026-10-05) whose newHead is 0d3d2cedc5548da41896201688a1dc0210208ea4 on that genesis, and run 2's terminal Off: the latest restore-terminal-off-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-05 receipt past its launch guard must be succeeded with offState confirmed, from run 20261005T160050Z-46759 or later

Requires the local fixture clean on main with the exact manifest, origin, single G1 genesis root and run 2's reset head as one commit on it; the Project three-action-rehearsal registered from this fixture under G1's registration marker (read-only probe) with no prepared or running fixture Session; the GitHub repository owned by the gh user, private, not archived, not a fork and carrying G1's disposable-fixture description

Requires runs 1 and 2's candidates exactly as reconciled: local branch, GitHub branch and pull request head of claude/write-start-marker-20261004T170245861Z / #1 at 58bcd9155cf64836994045ca63a7707d8b9ebe75 and claude/write-start-marker-20261005T155147519Z / #2 at 7f1390376f4d49215cd29fd98145d40198475613, checked before any change and again after the push; records all six tips with each pull request's state in candidatesBefore and candidatesAfter

Renders the amendment from run 2's reset tree into dot-directories of its run directory that Arcadia's discovery skips, and refuses unless only the fixture Plan changed (write-start-marker's next_action and the Plan's updated: date), the amended fixture passes G1's own validation rules (zero docs-sync errors, pointer at write-start-marker, serial depends_on, only write-start-marker ready), the genesis and run-2 trees carry the recorded input revisions 959a3b12c686… and 7a8dd4f5960f…, the amended input revision differs from both with an unchanged criteria fingerprint, and the other Actions' identities are unchanged; reads the live attempt lineage read-only and refuses if the amended input already has an attempt, or if a run-1 or run-2 Session that passed write-start-marker is still prepared or running, was not preserved by the worker, or has uncommitted work in its worktree

Runs a read-only dry-run docs sync of the amended tree against the live workspace and refuses unless it reports write-start-marker as an update (not skipped as older than its record) with no error and no skipped Action

Reads, read-only through Arcadia's own resolveOperatorGate and listUnsettledAgentAskProposals, every pending Agent Ask proposal and open Decision that would gate any of the three fixture Actions and every pending proposal for the fixture Project, and refuses untouched on any other than run 2's complete-write-start-marker-2026-10-05; that proposal must match this descriptor's agentAsk exactly (intent complete, target action/write-start-marker, Project three-action-rehearsal)

With this operator press as the operator's disposition, rejects only that proposal (by its exact proposal row id) through arcadia agent-ask settle --disposition rejected with the fixed settlement request id reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-run3-2026-10-05-reject-run2-complete: a preview that must report a document-free, queue-free rejection of exactly that proposal, then --apply --preview with that exact fingerprint, with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set inline on that one command; records the fingerprint, reads the settlement back when the apply's output is not proof, and refuses unless the gate is then clear. The settlement row and its pending Discord notification are the only workspace writes besides docs sync. An already-landed rejection under that request id is recognized on a rerun and not repeated; a proposal already settled by someone else, or absent, is left as it is

Only after all of that, commits exactly the validated Plan file on fixture main (one commit on run 2's reset head) and pushes refs/heads/main without force; then confirms GitHub main is the new head, rechecks both candidates, runs arcadia docs sync --project three-action-rehearsal --apply and confirms write-start-marker updated and each of the three Actions synced exactly once

Resumes safely: a reset commit already made by this script but not pushed is re-validated byte for byte and pushed; one already pushed proceeds to docs sync; after a succeeded run a rerun refuses as already reset

Writes a timestamped receipt under runs/<timestamp-pid>/ (githubRepository, genesis, previousMain, newHead, remoteMainAfter, candidatesBefore, candidatesAfter, supersededProposal with its proposal id, state, settlement request id and preview fingerprint, actionTextRevision with all three input revisions) on success and refusal, plus a failure handoff on refusal
never_does: Never previews, activates or deactivates production, and never creates, presses or changes a Grant or a Decision

Never settles, accepts or edits any Agent Ask proposal other than run 2's complete-write-start-marker-2026-10-05, never accepts that one, and never settles it when its preview would write a document or place a queue entry
Never changes any Action other than write-start-marker, its acceptance criteria, status or responsibility, PROJECT.md, the genesis check or the CI workflow
Never touches run 1's or run 2's branches, worktrees or pull requests #1 and #2, and never comments on, merges, closes or edits a pull request
Never force-pushes, rewrites, resets or rebases fixture history, and never deletes, renames, archives or changes the visibility of a repository
Never settles, commits or pushes before the amended fixture validates, and never edits the workspace database directly
Never restarts a service or worker, reinstalls the broker, or launches a Session
Never guesses or defaults the repository identifier, and never exports ARCADIA_WORKSPACE (it is set inline on the one settle command only)

success.effect: Fixture main on GitHub and locally is one reset commit on run 2's reset head that changes only write-start-marker's next_action and the Plan's updated: date (when later); run 2's pending complete proposal is rejected through the governed settle (or was already settled or absent) and nothing gates the fixture; docs sync applied the amendment with zero errors; the receipt carries the new fixture head, the previous main, runs 1 and 2's untouched candidate tips and the superseded proposal. Production is unchanged.
success.next: If Arcadia main moved on a runtime path since the last install, run recover-arcadia-host-services from a terminal with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set inline on that one command (never exported). Then run the run-3 G6 preflight preflight-three-action-rehearsal-run3-2026-10-05, which binds this receipt, and press the run-3 G7 grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-run3-2026-10-05 within 30 minutes of its passing receipt without pushing to Arcadia main in between.

failure.effect: The receipt and failure handoff name the failed precondition, the fixture state found, whether this run settled run 2's proposal (with its preview fingerprint) and whether it committed or pushed. Nothing was forced, rewritten or deleted, no other proposal was settled, and production, Grants and runs 1 and 2's candidates were not touched.
failure.next: Correct the named precondition and rerun with the same identifier; a rejection, commit or push this script already made is recognized and resumed, not repeated. If the handoff names other pending proposals or Decisions, settle them through their own governed path first. If it says the fixture moved by another path, do not edit it by hand: ask for a new reviewed reset.
